description:
The parent a module whose main content is JavaScript or TypeScript inherits. The node goals and the
        node gates are bound in airness-parent, because a Java module with a frontend inside it inherits
        airness-parent-java and cannot also inherit this one. All this parent changes is the default: the
        module itself is the node project, so the goals run in its own directory without a property.

        A consumer inheriting it declares pom packaging, since Maven then only runs the checks.
